payload.text: ISSUE:0671, on hv's word relayed by vc (10:21Z by vc's date -u): an intentd started without CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR sees no Claude session, so the estate page marks every held slot ORPHANED. Two halves. Intent.app's IntentCLI.environment() passes the login shell's CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, as it passes PATH. launchagent::write_plist carries it: the caller's value, else the one the plist already carries, so the boot heal never drops it, and start --at-login beside a running daemon can add it. Shape questions are with vc. Then a bank from tmp/wt-cc-0671, cc's own desk run and vc's judge. It lands after the push of the three fixes, on vc's word naming HEAD.
